highlights: far reaching views from the dormer bedroom
summary: Situated within an established residential area, this two-bedroom dormer bungalow offers a range of appealing features, including an elevated position, attractive gardens, off-road parking and far-reaching views from the first-floor dormer bedroom.
description:
The property is currently tenanted, generating a rental income of £575 per calendar month, and may appeal to investors seeking an existing rental opportunity, as well as a wider range of buyers looking for a bungalow with potential. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall, lounge, dining room, kitchen and bedroom to the ground floor, with a further bedroom situated within the dormer level, enjoying open views across the surrounding area. Externally, the property occupies an elevated position, approached via steps, with gardens to both the front and rear, planted with a variety of trees and shrubbery to provide established greenery. A block-paved hardstanding driveway offers valuable off-road car parking. The property is situated within convenient reach of the amenities available in Consett, a well-established County Durham town offering a variety of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and everyday services. Leisure facilities are also available at Consett Leisure Centre, and the surrounding area offers access to attractive countryside and walking routes, including the Derwent Walk. With its two-bedroom accommodation, outdoor space, driveway parking and elevated setting, this dormer bungalow offers an opportunity for buyers looking to acquire a property with scope to suit their own requirements. Offered with no onward chain and viewings are available immediately.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed door and provides access to both the lounge and the separate dining room.

LOUNGE The lounge features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light to fill the room, together with a radiator.

DINING ROOM The separate dining room features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light into the room, together with a radiator.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of high-gloss base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. There is tiling to the splashback and work surface areas, together with an integrated oven, hob and stainless steel chimney-style extractor positioned above. Plumbing is provided for an automatic washing machine, with additional space for a fridge freezer. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window provides natural light, while a UPVC-framed double-glazed door offers direct access to the rear garden.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panel bath, wash hand basin and WC. The room benefits from tiling to the splashback and vanity areas, together with a UPVC-framed double-glazed window providing natural light.

BEDROOM ONE - DORMER Situated within the dormer, Bedroom One is a spacious room offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture. A wide UPVC-framed double-glazed window takes full advantage of the property's elevated position, providing extensive views across the surrounding area. The room further benefits from a radiator and useful built-in storage.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light into the room, together with a radiator.

EXTERNALLY The bungalow occupies an elevated position, with steps leading up to the entrance. Gardens extend to the front, side and rear, planted with a variety of trees and shrubbery to provide established greenery and an attractive outdoor setting. The property also benefits from a block-paved hardstanding driveway, providing valuable off-road car parking.
